note: Who can get the CCB: residence, a child under 18, primary responsibility for care and citizenship or status conditions

How the reduction works: 7%, 13.5%, 19% and 23% above the first threshold, then a fixed amount plus 3.2%, 5.7%, 8% or 9.5% above the second. Its dollar amounts are for the July 2025 to June 2026 payment year
